title: Bounded per-component semantic context for STRIDE bundle construction
description: Routing hints are additionally validated against the finalized component paths and repository before publication and bundle construction.

topic.description: Mark a topic only when the source fully answers its question for the component; a mechanism name alone is not an answer. asset-criticality: What concrete disclosure, manipulation or outage harm applies to the named asset? account-onboarding: Can anyone create an account for {component}, or does onboarding require approval? attack-path-connection: Which production data or identities connect attack paths through this component? unrestricted-attribute-binding: Which fields accepted by {component} may users change themselves, and which require staff approval? browser-readable-session-credentials: How quickly can operators revoke a stolen session for {component} across its production clients? unbound-authorization-requests: Which callback protections does the production identity provider enforce for {component} independently of this client? database-query-concatenation: Which sensitive business records can the production database account used by {component} access? document-query-construction: Which other business datasets can the production database connection used by {component} access? blacklist-only-input-validation: Which parameter restrictions does infrastructure outside this repository enforce before requests reach {component}? route-by-route-authorization: Which cross-user or cross-tenant operations in {component} are intended for support staff or administrators? hand-rolled-token-verification: Which other production services accept identities or roles from tokens issued by {component}? missing-endpoint-authentication: Which operations in {component} are intended to be available without login? secrets-committed-to-source: Which production deployments still accept credentials exposed in the history of {component}? build-pipeline-mutable-refs: Who can publish the build inputs used by {component} without independent approval? browser-clients-without-bff: Which production restrictions outside this repository limit reuse of a stolen browser token for {component}? weak-cryptographic-primitives: Which stored business records in {component} require migration when this cryptographic primitive is replaced? process-reach: Which services, secrets or credentials can this process reach in production? server-request-reach: Which internal services or infrastructure credentials can server-side requests from this component reach? model-actions: Which production actions are enabled for the model in this component outside this repository?

routing_input.description: Compatibility string-or-list input normalized to literal repository-relative paths before dispatch.

business_context.description: Human-readable business and organization facts projected for one component. These values inform scenarios and impact; they do not override repository evidence or severity policy.

impact_is_material.description: Explicit declared impact: false means no material business harm under the conditions in impact_if_compromised; omit when unknown. Never inferred from an application label.

architecture_context.description: Human-readable security architecture facts projected for one component. These values inform topology and assumptions; they do not prove a control, boundary, threat, or finding.
